# voipms_phonebook_entry (Resource)

Manages a phonebook entry (`setPhonebook` / `delPhonebook`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "voipms_phonebook_group" "spam" {
  name = "Spam"
}

resource "voipms_phonebook_entry" "blocked_prefix" {
  name       = "Blocked prefix"
  number     = "999"
  group_name = voipms_phonebook_group.spam.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Contact name.
- `number` (String) Phone number or prefix.

### Optional

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID name override.
- `group` (String) Phonebook group id. Prefer `group_name` or a `voipms_phonebook_group` reference.
- `group_name` (String) Phonebook group name (e.g. `Spam`). Resolved to `group` when applying.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `speed_dial` (String) Speed-dial code.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VoIP.ms phonebook entry id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import voipms_phonebook_entry.blocked_prefix 6001
```
